intent_en: To justify the proposal for taxing capital gains by demonstrating that a large majority of Americans believe wealthy individuals are not paying their fair share of taxes.
previous_intent: To illustrate that a large majority of Americans are concerned about wealthy individuals not paying their fair share of taxes.
narration_support: Most Americans are bothered that wealthy people don't pay their fair share
chart_support: Donut chart showing the proportion of Americans bothered that some wealthy people do not pay their fair share of taxes
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links public concern about wealth taxation to the policy proposal of capital gains taxes, which is visually supported by the chart showing a large majority of Americans hold this view.
